scope.description: One named Canadian cyber-defence company researched entity-outward and problem-inward for a new organization dossier with capability, proof, public-need and action-path detail.

source.title: About StreamScan
source.locator: Company profile, operating model, founding year and Canadian R&D section
source.summary: StreamScan describes a Montréal cybersecurity company founded in 2011, a Canadian R&D centre and operational cybersecurity offerings spanning monitoring, incident response and compliance support.

leads.evidenceLocator: Company profile, product pages, federal and provincial records, patent and CENGN testbed account
followUpQuestions: Which independently verified defence projects and StreamEnclave deployment outcomes can a reviewer map without relying on company-authored claims?
reviewWarnings: The official site now publishes 300 place D'Youville, while the supplied LinkedIn profile still lists 180 Rue Peel; the candidate uses the official current address and city-level coordinates.

StreamScan's DND, Royal Canadian Air Force, Communications Security Establishment, CMMC Level 2 and Registered Practitioner Organization claims were not independently verified in this run and are excluded from proof relationships.
StreamEnclave speed, cost and certification-readiness outcome claims are organization-authored marketing and were excluded from the candidate's maturity evidence.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Resolved StreamScan's current identity, commercial portfolio, Canadian SOC model and current public contact from the official bilingual company surface.
Resolved the current StreamScan AI Inc. identity and 2011 Montréal company history through the Gouvernement du Québec supplier showcase.
Resolved the CDS patent, inventors, historical assignee and machine-learning network-detection architecture from the published patent record.
Resolved one independent CDS testbed configuration and result through CENGN while retaining its bounded 2018 scope.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: StreamScan develops a patented network-behaviour detection platform, offers managed IT and OT response from a Canadian SOC, and launched a bounded controlled-information enclave for defence-supply compliance preparation.
